name: World Trade Center
overview: The World Trade Center, while not directly mentioned in Scripture, can be reflected upon through biblical principles concerning earthly structures and their spiritual significance. Jesus' disciples marveled at the temple buildings, highlighting human admiration for grand constructions (Matthew 24:1). However, Colossians reminds us that such physical things are merely shadows pointing to Christ, the true substance (Colossians 2:17). Furthermore, Revelation reveals God's sovereign plan unfolding through Christ, assuring believers that all earthly events, including those involving great edifices, fall under His divine purpose (Revelation 1:1).
